keys.guide_settings_about_phone_software_info: Settings › About phone › Software information › tap Build number 7 times. Then Settings › Developer options › USB debugging. Connect the phone to your computer and allow it.
keys.guide_homebrew_installs_google_s_platfor: Homebrew installs Google\'s platform tools. Check that the phone shows up as \"device\".
keys.guide_app_lock_needs_its_accessibility_s: App lock needs its accessibility service, and Android 16 blocks that for apps installed outside the Play Store. It also switches the service off every time the app is reinstalled or updated over adb, so run this after each update.
keys.guide_if_you_have_it_on_your_mac_this_do: If you have it on your Mac, this does everything below in one go.

keys.guide_the_second_command_replaces_your_l: The second command replaces your list of enabled accessibility services; if you use others, turn them back on in Settings › Accessibility. Without a computer: App info › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then Settings › Accessibility › Installed apps › Good Utilities app lock.
keys.guide_samsung_keeps_its_battery_health_a: Samsung keeps its battery health (ASOC) and lifetime cycle count in a system service apps can\'t read, so they come over adb from your computer. Health changes slowly; syncing every few weeks is plenty.
keys.guide_reads_samsung_s_battery_report_and: Reads Samsung\'s battery report and sends health, cycles, first-use and manufacture dates to Good Utilities. It\'s in the Good Utilities repository.

keys.guide_only_adb_or_the_system_can_send_th: Only adb (or the system) can send these figures; other apps can\'t. Until the first sync, the Battery page shows its own estimate, which reads a couple of points high on Galaxy phones.
keys.card_manage_your_spending_log_purchases_: Manage your spending: log purchases and deposits, see your balance, and look back through your payment history. Everything stays on this phone.
keys.card_long_press_a_payment_to_start_selec: Long-press a payment to start selecting, then tap others or All. Deleting can be undone.
keys.card_your_purchases_and_deposits_show_up: Your purchases and deposits show up here.
keys.card_shown_on_home_and_in_the_widget: Shown on Home and in the widget
keys.card_what_was_yours_on_the_card_before_t: What was yours on the card before the first entry.
keys.card_its_balance_and_payment_history_wil: Its balance and payment history will be removed. This can\'t be undone.
keys.card_how_much_of_it_is_yours_right_now: How much of it is yours right now
keys.card_tap_to_set_up_a_card: Tap to set up a card
keys.id_pick_the_front_and_back_from_your_pho: Pick the front (and back) from your photos
keys.id_both_photos_are_removed_from_this_pho: Both photos are removed from this phone. Your Gallery copies, if any, stay where they are.
keys.id_keep_a_copy_of_your_ids_here_they_re_: Keep a copy of your IDs here. They\'re locked with your fingerprint and encrypted on this phone, and screenshots are blocked.
keys.id_crop_and_straighten_the_photos_in_gal: Crop and straighten the photos in Gallery (Edit › crop finds the card\'s edges), then pick them here, or share a photo to \"Add to Virtual cards\".
keys.id_swipe_down_or_up_on_a_card_to_see_its: Swipe down or up on a card to see its back.
keys.qr_share_a_link_or_text_from_any_app_and: Share a link or text from any app and choose \"QR code\".
keys.qr_this_is_too_long_for_a_qr_code_try_a_: This is too long for a QR code. Try a shorter link or less text.
keys.qr_this_text_is_too_long_for_a_qr_code: This text is too long for a QR code.
keys.random_enter_a_minimum_and_a_maximum: Enter a minimum and a maximum
keys.random_tap_the_dice_or_shake_your_phone_: Tap the dice or shake your phone to roll
keys.briefs_google_account_security_2_step_ve: Google Account › Security › 2-Step Verification › App passwords. Briefs keeps it encrypted on this phone.
keys.briefs_nothing_under_yet_label_an_email_: Nothing under \"%1$s\" yet. Label an email in Gmail and it shows up here the next time you open Briefs.
keys.briefs_briefs_forgets_the_app_password_a: Briefs forgets the app password and removes the synced emails from this phone. Nothing changes in Gmail.
keys.briefs_your_newsletters_and_articles_fro: Your newsletters and articles from one Gmail label, as clean, readable pages. Briefs only syncs while it\'s open: nothing runs in the background and there are no notifications.
keys.briefs_in_gmail_make_a_filter_for_your_n: In Gmail, make a filter for your newsletters\' senders that applies the label, so new briefs show up here automatically.
keys.briefs_gmail_has_no_label_called_check_t: Gmail has no label called \"%1$s\". Check the spelling (labels inside others are written Parent/Label).
keys.briefs_gmail_didn_t_accept_the_address_o: Gmail didn\'t accept the address or app password. App passwords are 16 letters, made in your Google Account › Security.
keys.jp_share_an_image_from_any_app_and_pick_: Share an image from any app and pick Read Japanese.
keys.jp_text_is_recognised_on_this_phone_hori: Text is recognised on this phone. Horizontal text works best; vertical manga text is supported but less reliable.
keys.jp_dictionary_jmdict_edrdg_cc_by_sa_4_0_: Dictionary: JMdict (EDRDG), CC BY-SA 4.0. Word splitting: Kuromoji. Text recognition and translation: ML Kit.

keys.jp_read_the_screen_you_are_on: Read the screen you are on
keys.jp_swipe_down_tap_read_japanese_works_ov: Swipe down, tap Read Japanese. Works over Mihon, games, video and anything else, then tap a line for readings and meanings.
keys.jp_app_lock_s_accessibility_service_is_o: App lock\'s accessibility service is off
keys.jp_uses_the_same_accessibility_service_a: Uses the same accessibility service as App lock. It captures the screen only when you tap the tile.
keys.jp_the_tile_needs_it_to_take_the_screens: The tile needs it to take the screenshot. After a reinstall, run ~/enable-applock.sh on your computer.

keys.jp_meanings_and_parts_of_speech_for_ever: Meanings and parts of speech for every word, with no internet needed after this download. JMdict (EDRDG), CC BY-SA 4.0.

keys.jp_translates_each_line_to_english_with_: Translates each line to English with ML Kit. The model (about 30 MB) also downloads by itself the first time you open a line.
keys.jp_show_latin_letters_under_the_kana: Show Latin letters under the kana
keys.jp_tap_the_star_on_a_word_while_reading_: Tap the star on a word while reading and it will be saved here for practice.
keys.jp_of_words_knew_on_the_first_go_come_ba: %1$s of %2$s words knew on the first go. Come back tomorrow and read something new.
keys.jp_no_japanese_text_found_in_this_pictur: No Japanese text found in this picture.

keys.jp_listen_see_alternatives_and_get_the_o: Listen, see alternatives, and get the online translation
keys.jp_downloading_the_translation_model_abo: Downloading the translation model (about 30 MB), waiting for Wi-Fi if needed…
